text: Linear algebra: factorizations, saddle systems, restarting and mass eigenpairs Small fixed matrices compare factorization and refinement, symmetric-indefinite solves, restarted eigenpairs and a consistent-mass string. Independent references distinguish residual from solution error, algebraic from discretization error, and counted operator actions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-linear-algebra-spectral-2026-11-24-r3 from the ZIP. This command executes all 4 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Symmetric saddle systems and Schur preconditioning MINRES and GMRES use the same original-system residual criterion and are checked against the ideal Schur three-point spectrum. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Algebraic mixed-Poisson/Stokes-type blocks with velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. The common original-system residual tolerance is 1e-9. Editorial clarification A dense, ideal-Schur educational control, not a complete Stokes PDE solver or a scalable approximate preconditioner. Adopted numerical method Stored-basis Lanczos least squares provides the educational MINRES variant; GMRES uses two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt. An SPD congruence preserves symmetry. The internal target is min(configured rtol, fixed forward-error limit / kappa_infinity), using only the matrix. The independent solution is not a stopping input.
